confidence_notes: Low confidence. I used 6 searches (1 RBA, 5 price). No aggregated Siargao price index turned up. Food and drink anchors rest on a few General Luna venue menu prices and travel-guide ranges in search results: cappuccino about 140-180 PHP, local beer about 90-150 PHP, cocktails about 200-320 PHP, and one house-wine-by-the-glass listing near 200 PHP. The inexpensive meal blends roughly 150-300 PHP for local and casual eateries. Peso prices were converted to USD at an approximate PHP/USD rate assumed from general knowledge, not searched. Wine relies on that single listing plus a typical relationship of about 2x beer. The mid-range three-course meal for two is extrapolated from typical starter, main and dessert price levels and is the weakest food anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I ran no accommodation search and inspected no live listings. Lodging in Siargao swings widely with season and surf-event dates, and I assumed July 2026 is shoulder-season. The FX figure is the RBA observation as reported by one web search of RBA pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: General Luna is Siargao's main tourist hub, so anchors follow tourist-oriented surf-town pricing. Food and drink come from General Luna venue and guide prices found in search, above mainland Philippine provincial levels. Accommodation is by analogy, from general knowledge, to Philippine island and surf destinations such as El Nido and La Union, with a hostel and boutique-resort mix.
